context_notes: 01-12 done in 35 min inline (Copilot sequential mode). Ship loop: typecheck + eslint src tests -> build -> check:secrets -> local e2e (full suite now 108 tests, ~5 min) -> commit -> git push origin HEAD:main -> wait for Vercel commit status (gh api repos/ema-12-martins/new_recipe_website/commits/SHA/status) -> test:e2e:prod, with db:*:dev substituted for db:*:prod. npm run test:integration also runs the whole tests/integration folder; use npx vitest run <file> for a per-file count. PowerShell treats [locale] as a wildcard: use -LiteralPath or [System.IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory, and git pathspecs need [[]locale]. gsd-tools roadmap.update-plan-progress and requirements.ready-ids/mark-complete work; STATE.md body/frontmatter must still be updated by hand. AUTH-02 and AUTH-04 are held by the shared-ID gate. Uncommitted milestone.lock and state.json are tool-generated and never committed.
